title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the maximum electrical energy generated in kWhr.

title: Efficiency Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Carnot efficiency formula to calculate the efficiency of the heat engine.

title: Heat Transfer Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive and use the correct expression for the heat drawn from the rock, incorporating mass, specific heat, and temperature change.

title: Integration Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should set up the integral correctly to calculate the total work done by the heat engine.

title: Unit Conversion
description: Optional Criteria: The student should convert the final energy result from Joules to kWhr correctly, using the conversion factor.

title: Temperature Conversion
description: Optional Criteria: The student should correctly convert temperatures from Celsius to Kelvin when applying the Carnot efficiency formula.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the heat transfer calculations and the work done expressions.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as density and volume, are included in the calculations.
